DearStudents, Why do we study and practice art? Such questions arise from the common perception that art is an "innate talent." However, just like any other field of humanities, the study of art also demands our attention and intellect. This textbook, which focuses on areas like visual art, sculpture, music, dance, drama, and cinema, goes beyond mere knowledge acquisition in these subjects. It aims to encourage creative activities related to these artforms. Beyond the conventional method of practicing any art form with a competitive mindset, this textbook aspires to revitalize the educational process creatively by fostering a deep understanding of all art forms.

Through this book, we delve into various timeless aspects of visual arts, cinema, dance, music, theater, and more. This textbook is designed in such a way to understand art through activities. The art education textbook aims at the all-round personality development of children, like having an exemplary perspective in the approach to the surroundings and fellow beings, acquiring skills and knowledge in such a way as to be able to create and share innovative thoughts that will strengthen the society, and nurturing creative abilities and finding their own place in the society. For that purpose, five fields, namely painting and sculpture, music, drama, cinema and dance, are included in this textbook. That's why various projects have been included in this textbook considering the taste of each of you, the fields of study required by the period, and the future career prospects. By preparing these projects you can go far in your field of interest.

Along with this textbook, the projects are planned to make the most of the knowledge and experiences you have gained from the art education lessons from class five to nine. Projects are included in the six chapters of this textbook in the areas of painting, sculpture, music, drama, cinema and dance, with the aim of nurturing your sense of inquiry and research aptitude. A total of three projects, one per term, should be submitted in an academic year. The project structure and general guidelines are given in the introduction. Other suggestions according to the characteristics of each project, the learning activities leading to it, etc. are included in the respective lessons. The pages provided at the end of the book shall be used for planning the selected projects. You can also seek help from parents, teachers, friends and experts related to your chosen field to prepare the project.
The ultimate goal of the art education textbook is to create an "art literate new generation".
